findings.evidence: Statement: Forming quadratic equations with new roots. The FP1-2.3 questions ask only to 'Find the sum of the new roots' (items i13, i15, i17) or 'Find the product of the new roots' (items i14, i16, i18).
findings.fix: Add a question requiring students to form the quadratic equation from transformed roots.
